description: The University of Virginia Biocomplexity team publishes a coarse synthetic population for Kenya through the SPW series. Zenodo lists an open data ZIP, README and contact-matrix CSV under CC BY 4.0. The README describes people and households, residences, daily activity sites and the assignment of people to those sites. Its source table identifies DHS household data, GPW demographic counts, World Bank activity templates and OpenStreetMap-derived points of interest. These synthetic agents can form a starting population for national emergency-service reachability or infrastructure-disruption simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the Kenya release. A limitation is that daily activities are generated, not observed trip traces or measured healthcare demand. The README does not supply a Kenya road graph or facility capacity and does not demonstrate accuracy for any particular county. The ZIP was not downloaded; synthetic person totals, coordinate quality and upstream source reuse conditions were not independently checked.
